title: Design System: Honeypot IDS Knowledge Hub

display.purpose: Home-hero headline only; Inter 800, heavy negative tracking.

label.purpose: Every machine signal: eyebrows, table headers, metadata, badges, code, diagram text. JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift under cards/doc-cards on hover (paired with translateY(-2px)).

shadows.name: button-glow
shadows.purpose: The one green-tinted glow; primary action hover only.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Deep lift for the search modal overlay.

components.name: Primary Button (sheared)
components.description: Terminal action button; neon fill with a 10px parallelogram shear.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; background: var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); color: var(--color-bg-primary, #080808); padding:0.62rem 1.55rem; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.01em; text-decoration:none; border:none; clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: background .18s ease, transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#33ff66; transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,255,65,0.22); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/secondary action; transparent with a border that turns green on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; background:transparent; color: var(--color-text-primary, #f0f0f0); padding:0.62rem 1.55rem; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; border:1px solid var(--color-border-accent, #333); clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: border-color .18s ease, background .18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); background: rgba(0,255,65,0.06); }

components.name: Doc Card
components.description: Navigational card with a green icon tile, mono tag, title, description and nudging arrow.
components.html: pattern_rulesRequest shapeGeneric and specific URI patterns, encoding evasion and header anomalies.→
components.css: .ds-doc-card { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:0.85rem; padding:1rem 1.05rem; background: var(--color-bg-secondary, #0f0f0f); border:1px solid var(--color-border, #222); color: var(--color-text-secondary, #999); text-decoration:none; transition: border-color .18s, background .18s, transform .18s, box-shadow .18s; } .ds-doc-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--color-border-accent, #333); background: var(--color-bg-card-hover, #1a1a1a); box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-doc-card__icon { flex:0 0 auto; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:2.15rem; height:2.15rem; border:1px solid var(--color-border, #222); background: var(--color-bg-tertiary, #161616); color: var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); } .ds-doc-card__body { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.18rem; min-width:0; } .ds-doc-card__tag { font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.58rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.1em; color: var(--color-text-muted, #555); } .ds-doc-card__title { font-size:0.86rem; font-weight:600; color: var(--color-text-primary, #f0f0f0); } .ds-doc-card__desc { font-size:0.76rem; line-height:1.55; } .ds-doc-card__arrow { align-self:center; color: var(--color-text-muted, #555); transition: color .18s, transform .18s; } .ds-doc-card:hover .ds-doc-card__arrow { color: var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); transform:translateX(2px); }

components.name: Admonition
components.description: Callout with a green left-rule, a hairline green top gradient and a mono uppercase title.
components.html:
Measured vs configured

Configured half-life is 300 s, but a recorded run measured the effective half-life at 529 s.
components.css: .ds-admonition { position:relative; margin:1.15rem 0; padding:0.9rem 1.1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-border, #222); border-left:2px solid var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); background: var(--color-bg-card, #121212); font-size:0.9rem; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #999); } .ds-admonition::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:1px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41), transparent); opacity:0.35; } .ds-admonition__title { font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight:600; font-size:0.68rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.09em; color: var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); margin-bottom:0.35rem; } .ds-admonition p { margin:0; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Reference table with green mono uppercase headers and row-hover fill.
components.css: .ds-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.82rem; border:1px solid var(--color-border, #222); background: var(--color-bg-secondary, #0f0f0f); } .ds-table th { background: var(--color-bg-tertiary, #161616); color: var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); text-align:left; padding:0.55rem 0.8rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border-accent, #333); font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.68rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; } .ds-table td { padding:0.55rem 0.8rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border, #222); color: var(--color-text-secondary, #999); } .ds-table tr:hover td { background: var(--color-bg-card-hover, #1a1a1a); } .ds-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom:none; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Section sidebar link; transparent left-rule that turns green and fills when active.
components.html: DetectionCapabilitiesSeeded CVEsSuricata Network IDS
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; } .ds-nav__title { font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.68rem; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.1em; color: var(--color-text-muted, #555); margin:0 0 0.65rem; padding:0 0.55rem; } .ds-nav__link { display:block; padding:0.32rem 0.55rem; font-size:0.78rem; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #999); border-left:2px solid transparent; text-decoration:none; transition: color .15s, background .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: var(--color-text-primary, #f0f0f0); background: var(--color-bg-tertiary, #161616); } .ds-nav__link.active { color: var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); border-left-color: var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); background: rgba(0,255,65,0.06); font-weight:500; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Mono status pill; green on tertiary surface.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-block; background: var(--color-bg-tertiary, #161616); color: var(--color-accent-green, #00ff41); padding:0.12rem 0.45rem; font-size:0.64rem; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; border:1px solid var(--color-border, #222); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; }

narrative.overview: A dark, instrument-panel reference built for people who read docs like a console: scanning for the exact signal in a field of calm gray. The world is almost entirely grayscale with a single neon green (#00ff41) doing all the signalling, never decoration. Inter carries prose; JetBrains Mono carries every machine signal in uppercase with wide tracking. Corners are square; depth comes from borders and tonal layering, not resting shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Four-step near-black grayscale surface ramp with #222/#333 hairline borders.
Exactly one accent hue: neon green #00ff41, used on ≤10% of any screen.
Square corners everywhere; depth from borders + tonal layering, not radius.
Inter for prose, JetBrains Mono (uppercase, tracked) for every machine/data signal.
Ambient machine texture: 64px grid, faint green radial bloom, scan-line and radar motifs.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Green appears on ≤10% of any screen and only to mark a live signal (link, metric, active state, accent edge). If green is decorating, it is wrong.

rules.name: The No Second Hue Rule
rules.body: No blue, amber, or red. Severity and state are expressed through green vs. gray steps; warnings use a light-gray #d4d4d4 rule, never orange.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: If text is monospace and uppercase, it is a machine signal (label, metric, header, code), never prose.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; borders and tonal steps carry structure. A shadow is a response to state (hover, overlay), never resting decoration.

dos: Do express every token through the CSS custom properties in global.css; add new tokens there rather than inlining hex.
Do keep green scarce — links, active states, metrics, and one accent edge per element.
Do set every machine signal in JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked.
Do keep corners square; use the 10px clip-path shear only for primary/footer-nav buttons.
Do convey depth with borders + tonal steps; add shadow only on hover/overlay.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue.
Don't put raw hex in page markup — tokens only.
Don't round corners or add resting drop-shadows to cards.
Don't set body sentences in monospace, or large body text in neon green.
Don't fabricate figures; every number traces to source or a cited report.
